newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Weider Nutrition started buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Weider Nutrition started buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said it started coverage of Weider Nutrition International Inc with a buy rating on Wednesday.
-- Shares rose 1/4 to 14 in early trading.
-- Salomon was the one of the co-underwriters of the company's May IPO. Shares went public at $11.
-- Analyst Diana Temple said in a report the nutritional supplements company can achieve revenue growth of 20 percent with 25 percent internal earnings growth.

-- Cited its strong brand name, good prospects for a profitable international expansion, double-digit growth in the industry, favorable demographics, an improved regulatory climate, a fragmented industry, and the company's ability to create and grow other brands.

-- She estimates Weider will earn $0.74 in the calendar year of 1997, $0.84 in 1998 and $1.05 in 1999. Temple said Weider could sell at 20 times calendar EPS, giving the stock an upside of $20 a share in 1998.

-- Temple noted that 1997 sales growth should be 17 percent to $217 million, including an estimated drop in melatonin sales of $6 to $8 million. Excluding the melatonin drop, sales would grow 25 percent. ((J. Westhoven, Wall Street Desk 212 859 1881))
